swapZAsset(uint256[],((uint256,uint256),.details: Validates inputs, checks non-zero public inputs, sanitizes private messages, validates and spends nullifiers, and processes the swap through the identified plugin.

params.inputs: The public input parameters to be passed to the verifier (see `ZSwapPublicSignals.sol`).
params.paymasterCompensation: The compensation amount for the paymaster.
params.swapData: The encoded data to proceed with the swap. (see `PluginDataDecoderLib.sol`).
params.transactionOptions: A 17-bit number where the 8 LSB defines the cachedForestRootIndex, the 1 MSB enables/disables the taxi tree, and other bits are reserved.

returns.zAccountUtxoBusQueuePos: The position in the UTXO bus queue for the zAccount.

updatePluginStatus(address,bool).details: Emits a `ZSwapPluginUpdated` event when the plugin status is changed.

params.plugin: The address of the plugin to update.
params.status: The new status of the plugin (enabled or disabled).

swapZAsset(uint256[],((uint256,uint256),.notice: Swaps a Z-Asset using the provided parameters.

updatePluginStatus(address,bool).notice: Updates the status of a ZSwap plugin.

userdoc.notice: The ZSwap contract facilitates the swapping of zAssets within the Panther ecosystem, allowing users to spend zAsset UTXO and create another. It integrates with plugins that handle swap processes.
